notes.title: Kitten Super Adventure - New Heights VR Released!
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28660160/7984fc8fad7663b763f381d42195f853e9031e0e.jpg

KSA - NEW HEIGHTS VR RELEASE NOTES
Get the game here: 
https://gamejolt.com/games/kitten-super-adventure/43033

Upon releasing the New Heights mini-game, it received a lot of great feedback and not too long after it's release I got my hands on an Oculus device, this launched me into full "VR Dev Mode"! 

After a lot of learning and laughing while enjoying the process, taaadaaa! 
KSA - New Heights VR is here! 

The game is currently on sale for $0.50 (regular price is $0.99) for the first week and then will go back to regular pricing afterwards.

For a VR game, this is probably one of the cheapest you'll find around!

Be a kitten, change your outfits, fly through the forest, lava pits and canyons! Collect catnip bags and boost on through, gaining the longest distance you can!

KSA - New Heights Promo
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3iV33U0OeBM

Updates:
The VR version brings a few new updates such as:
- improved performance
- better terrain designs (more detail, grass, plants, etc.)
- removed stuttering intro video and replaced with fade in/out logo
- Full VR functionality
- removed "Steam" button and replaced with "reset game" button
- can reset game from "reset" button on title screen

*The game was designed with an Oculus device and has not been tested on an HTC Vive device, keep this in mind*

Please send any questions, concerns, issues or even ideas for future updates to dizzymediainc@gmail.com

PIRATING NOTICE

Not too long ago I released the HD Remake for "Kitten Super Adventure - New Heights", which a lot of people really liked and for some odd reason, even though it's entirely free, the game was torrented a million times all over the internet v_v

Even though it was probably only $20+ worth of downloads that was lost due to the torrents, it put up a red flag and showed me just exactly how fast this can happen (literally within an hour). With this in mind my future builds will have more security in the store and core game in order to avoid pirating in the future. 

Please do not pirate something I have worked a great deal on, I am one person trying to make a living, please offer whatever support you can in my venture ^_^

notes.title: VR UI Update
notes.content:
After a lot of hard work and tinkering I am pretty happy with how the game UI works :) considering this is my first time developing for VR, converting over non VR UI to VR UI was a bit of a learning curve :P
(keep in mind this does look a bit different with the headset on)

https://youtu.be/ZEKYFC7J6eg

The only real issue i'm having is the selection pop (where the ui element pops out when you hover over it), which seems to be a bit jittery (expanding the box collider causes other issues)

Fixes:
- Difficulty setting (stop repeat select/pop select)
- Shop items/skins (fixed spacing and removed selection pop)
- Included item/skins scrolling buttons for VR gameplay (up & down)
- Fixed fades/transitions for selections (start game, main menu, etc.)
- Fixed all selection sound effects timing
- Re-wrote all button select code(s) for better functionality
- A few other small things

Fly, dodge, enjoy catnip and do it in style! 

Download: 
https://gamejolt.com/games/kitten-super-adventure/43033

Promo: https://youtu.be/3iV33U0OeBM

KSA - New Heights is a small mini game made to promote the larger game Kitten Super Adventure.

notes.title: Kitten Super Adventure - New Heights *HD Remake* Release
notes.content:
Try the new version of Kitten Super Adventure - New Heights for FREE!!
Fly, dodge and collect new outfits in this addictive, fast paced mini-game! 

https://youtu.be/3iV33U0OeBM

Download: 
https://gamejolt.com/games/kitten-super-adventure/43033

Updates:
- Full remake/upgrade of fly areas (terrains, models, etc.)
- Added custom lava shader, mist, etc. to lava pit fly areas.
- Added 2 new outfits (Halloween & King Kitten)
- Added particles to all kitten outfits
- Added sun shafts and other graphical effects
- Adjusted steering speed
- Updated UI
- More!

KSA - New Heights is a small mini game made to promote the larger game 
Kitten Super Adventure.
